Industry Focus

Industries We Serve

Sector-specific non-destructive testing and asset integrity management tailored to the key industrial economic sectors of East Africa.

Upstream / Midstream / Downstream

Oil and Gas

Pipelines, storage tanks, refineries and process plant across upstream offshore fields, cross-country pipelines, and downstream processing facilities.

Sector Details
Thermal / Hydro / Geothermal

Power Generation and Geothermal

Boilers, turbines, heat exchangers, steam pipework, and separator vessels in thermal, hydro, geothermal and renewable power facilities.

Sector Details
Heavy Equipment & Structural

Mining & Heavy Infrastructure

Structural steelwork, excavators, draglines, crushers, mill trunnions, shaft gantries, and material handling equipment.

Sector Details
Rail Tracks & Rolling Stock

Railways & Transportation

Continuous welded rails (USFD), thermit weld quality verification, locomotive axles, and rolling stock wheelset integrity.

Sector Details
Heavy Processing Plant

Cement

Rotary kilns, ducting, structural supports, cyclone towers, and plant maintained within tight emergency shutdown windows.

Sector Details
Hygienic Welded Systems

Breweries, Beverage & Food Processing

Stainless steel tanks, pressure vessels, hygienic process pipework, fermentation cellars, and steam boilers.

Sector Details
Agro-Industrial Processing

Sugar Industry

Boilers, evaporators, mill structures, crystallizers, and pressure equipment inspected during off-crop maintenance turnarounds.

Sector Details
Submerged Assets & Jetties

Marine and Ports

Port berth jetties, gantry cranes, vessel hulls, mooring bollards, and submerged infrastructure inspected by commercial NDT divers.

Sector Details
